title: Business logic inside route handlers
content: Recent reviews repeatedly flagged route handlers that calculate totals, branch on business rules, and call repositories directly instead of delegating to services.

title: Weak request validation
content: Inputs are often used directly from payload dictionaries without checking required fields, value ranges, or allowed states.

title: Missing exception handling around external operations
content: Database and network calls repeatedly lack try/except handling and contextual failure logging.

title: Repeated duplicate business logic
content: Validation and discount calculations are often copied across multiple handlers instead of extracted into shared helpers.
